title: Bounds Toolkit
statement:
Implement lower and upper bounds on a sorted array. The lower bound is the first position with value at least x, and the upper bound is the first position with value strictly greater than x.

Input
Read n q, then n integers in nondecreasing order, then q lines of TYPE x. TYPE is FIRST, LAST, or COUNT.

Output
Print the first or last 1-based index of x, or 0 if absent. COUNT prints its frequency.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000. Each array value and target has absolute value at most 10⁹.
